flows.exit.indirect_cn_target.quote: The Target Company holds the entire equity interests in each of the Project Companies
flows.exit.indirect_cn_target.formula: BVI 公司持有四家内地项目公司全部股权：转让 BVI 股权即间接转让内地应税财产（公告2015年第7号第一条）

flows.exit.cn_value_ratio.formula: 评估值：长期股权投资 42,047.36 ÷ 资产总额 42,052.48（RMB 万元）= 99.99%（7号公告第四条第（一）项看境外企业股权价值来自中国应税财产的比例）

flows.exit.cn_asset_ratio.formula: 账面值：长期股权投资 12,394.73 ÷ 资产总额 12,399.85（RMB 万元）= 99.96%（7号公告第四条第（二）项看资产构成）

flows.exit.limited_functions_and_risks.quote: It is a newly established company with no substantial business operations at present.
flows.exit.limited_functions_and_risks.formula: 估值报告称该 BVI 公司是持股平台、无实质经营（pdf 60），截至估值日未开展实际经营（pdf 79）——7号公告第四条第（三）项

flows.exit.listed_market_trade.formula: 转让标的是 BVI 有限公司 100% 股权，经公开挂牌由唯一合格竞买人受让（pdf 8），不是上市股票的公开市场交易

present.HOLD.quote: The Target Company is a company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands with limited liability

present.exit_route.quote: Under the Disposal, Yunnan Water (Hong Kong) has agreed to sell, and Global Environment Investment has agreed to acquire, 100% interest in the Target Company.

event.exit.quote: The Consideration of the Disposal is RMB296,259,700, which was determined and equivalent to the appraised value of the Disposal Interest as at 31 December 2021 by an independent PRC valuer

event.on.quote: The Consideration was paid by Global Environment Investment on 3 November 2022.

company_estimate.quote: The estimated tax effect of the Disposal amounted to RMB11,215,000 represents the PRC enterprise income tax calculated based on a tax rate of 10% on taxable disposal gain arising from the transfer of equity interests in the Project Companies
company_estimate.use: 只作比对：10% 对应应税所得约 RMB112.15m，即扣除额约 RMB184.11m；通函未披露所用的收入与扣除额，卖方对 BVI 股权的成本也未以金额披露

notes: 来源：雲南水務投資（6839.HK）2023-02-24 通函（cases/sources/K4-yunnanwater-2023/source.pdf）。香港公司出售持有四家内地项目公司的 BVI 公司：间接转让内地应税财产。
四家项目公司合为 OP（BVI 公司对四家均持股 100%，评估值合计等于其长期股权投资）；上市母公司（内地股份公司）在卖方之上，不建模。
BVI 公司不在三地之内：现有结构的税额直接对现有结构求值；规划器的候选只在内地、香港、新加坡放中间控股公司。
